channel.title: Arch Linux: Recent news updates
channel.description: The latest and greatest news from the Arch Linux distribution.

item.title: linux-firmware >= 20251021-1 upgrade requires manual intervention
item.description:
With 20251021-1, the firmware files have been split into several packages. Due to the file moves, the upgrade requires manual intervention:

pacman -Rdd linux-firmware
pacman -Syu linux-firmware

Upgrading without doing this first will fail with file conflicts in /usr/lib/firmware.
item.dc:creator: Jan Alexander Steffens

item.title: NVIDIA 590 driver drops Pascal support
item.description:
The nvidia 590 driver series no longer supports Pascal (GTX 10xx) GPUs. If you own one, switch to nvidia-580xx-dkms from the AUR before upgrading nvidia-utils.

Turing and newer cards are unaffected. See the wiki for details.
item.dc:creator: Peter Jung

item.title: Python 3.14 is coming to [core]
item.description: Python 3.14 will move from [core-testing] to [core] soon. Packages installed with pip outside of pacman, and AUR packages that install Python modules, will need to be rebuilt.
item.dc:creator: Robin Candau

item.title: Transition to the new WoW64 wine and wine-staging
item.description: wine and wine-staging are now built in pure WoW64 mode. Existing 32-bit prefixes may need to be recreated.
item.dc:creator: Robin Candau
